definitions.explanation: A paper template used as a guide for cutting fabric when making clothes or other sewn items.

examples.english: I cut the fabric following the pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{型紙|かたがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This book comes with patterns included.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{型紙|かたがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縫|ぬ}った→縫う：00326_nuu⟧。
examples.english: I made my own pattern and sewed a dress.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (form/mold) + ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧→がみ (paper)

Note: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ becomes {紙|がみ} (rendaku) in this compound.

USAGE:
- {型紙|かたがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写|うつ}す→写す：01227_utsusu⟧ (to trace a pattern)
- {型紙|かたがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to create a pattern)
- {型紙|かたがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧ (to place a pattern on fabric)
Used in sewing, dressmaking, and craft projects. Professional patterns often come in standard sizes.

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
- ⟦パターン→パターン：05456_pataan⟧ (pattern - loanword, also commonly used)
